heading_stack: Private banking and wealth management risks
payload.block_text: Pooled investment vehicles (PIVs) are small investments pooled together from a large group of investors. PIVs can be used in Ponzi schemes and insider trading. Additionally, criminals might engage in trade-based money laundering using SPVs and PIVs. Criminals manipulate trade transactions between SPVs and PIVs by deflating or inflating prices. This process enables the movement of illicit funds while disguising it as legitimate trade activity.
